subtopics.label: Cardiac Development and Regeneration
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing heart development, cardiomyocyte differentiation, and cardiac regeneration, including studies in zebrafish, mouse, and human stem cell models. Encompasses transcription factor regulation of cardiogenesis, cardiomyocyte polyploidy, and epicardial progenitor biology.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and cellular mechanisms of cardiomyocyte differentiation, cardiogenesis, and cardiac regeneration in zebrafish, mouse, and stem cell models.

subtopics.label: Neural Differentiation and Cortical Development
subtopics.description: Studies on the specification, differentiation, and circuit integration of neurons and neural progenitor cells during brain development, including cortical layering, interneuron maturation, and axon guidance and pruning. Encompasses transcription factor control of neural stem cell fate and cortical patterning.
subtopics.short_description: Specification and circuit integration of neurons and progenitors during brain development, including cortical layering and axon guidance.

subtopics.label: Pluripotent Stem Cell Biology and Reprogramming
subtopics.description: Research on the generation, maintenance, and epigenetic regulation of pluripotent stem cells (ESCs and iPSCs), including reprogramming mechanisms, chromatin state transitions, and genomic stability. Covers applications of iPSCs for disease modeling and directed differentiation.
subtopics.short_description: Generation, epigenetic regulation, and directed differentiation of ESCs and iPSCs for disease modeling and developmental research.

subtopics.label: Organoid Models for Developmental and Disease Research
subtopics.description: Use of brain, lung, pancreatic, and other organoid systems derived from human pluripotent or patient-specific stem cells to model developmental processes, congenital conditions, and disease pathology. Includes cerebral organoids for neuropsychiatric disorders and airway/islet organoids for infectious and metabolic disease.
subtopics.short_description: Brain, lung, pancreatic, and other organoid systems derived from human stem cells to model congenital conditions and disease pathology.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell Fate and Differentiation
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular regulation of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell differentiation, including epigenetic and transcriptional control of lineage specification, clonal hematopoiesis, and the role of mutations in myeloid and lymphoid fate decisions. Encompasses single-cell multi-omics approaches to dissect hematopoietic hierarchies.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic and transcriptional control of hematopoietic stem cell differentiation, clonal hematopoiesis, and myeloid and lymphoid fate decisions.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic and Chromatin Regulation of Cell Identity
subtopics.description: Studies on how chromatin modifications, histone variants, DNA methylation, and chromatin remodeling complexes regulate cell identity, lineage commitment, and developmental transitions. Includes PRC2 function, histone H1/H3.3 roles, and 3D genome organization in stem cells and differentiating tissues.
subtopics.short_description: Histone modifications, DNA methylation, and 3D genome organization governing lineage commitment and developmental transitions.

subtopics.label: Osteoblast Differentiation and Skeletal Development
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular pathways governing osteoblast differentiation, bone formation, and skeletal patterning, including signaling through ERK/MAPK, hedgehog, Wnt, and GSK3-β pathways. Encompasses studies on craniosynostosis, skeletal stem cells, and mineralization defects.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular pathways controlling bone formation, skeletal stem cells, and mineralization, including craniosynostosis and hedgehog/Wnt signaling.

subtopics.label: Intestinal Epithelial Lineage and Stem Cell Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on the specification, maintenance, and plasticity of intestinal epithelial cell lineages, including Lgr5+ intestinal stem cells, goblet cells, and colonocyte identity. Encompasses Wnt/β-catenin signaling, niche interactions, and lineage reversion in homeostasis and cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Specification and plasticity of intestinal epithelial lineages, Lgr5+ stem cells, and Wnt/β-catenin niche interactions in homeostasis and cancer.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Specification and Vascular Development
subtopics.description: Research on the origin, specification, and functional maintenance of endothelial cells and vascular progenitors, including angiogenesis, blood-brain barrier formation, and organ-specific vascular zonation. Covers ETS transcription factor control of endothelial identity and endothelial colony-forming cells.
subtopics.short_description: Origin and maintenance of endothelial cells and vascular progenitors, including angiogenesis, blood-brain barrier formation, and organ-specific zonation.

subtopics.label: Neural Tube Defects and Developmental Genetics
subtopics.description: Genetic and genomic studies investigating the etiology of neural tube defects including spina bifida, encompassing genome-wide association studies, copy number variant analyses, regulatory genomic elements, and nutritional risk factors such as vitamin B12. Includes developmental genetics of related congenital malformations.
subtopics.short_description: Genetic and genomic etiology of spina bifida and related congenital malformations, including GWAS, copy number variants, and nutritional risk factors.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic β Cell Differentiation and Function
subtopics.description: Research on the differentiation, identity maintenance, and functional regulation of pancreatic β cells, including transcription factor control, epigenetic regulation, and lineage plasticity relevant to diabetes. Encompasses CDK4 signaling, ALDH1A3 inhibition, RAR-β deletion, and SARS-CoV-2-induced transdifferentiation.
subtopics.short_description: Transcription factor control, epigenetic regulation, and lineage plasticity of pancreatic β cells relevant to diabetes and viral transdifferentiation.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Differentiation and Adipogenesis
subtopics.description: Studies on the molecular regulation of preadipocyte commitment and adipocyte differentiation, including circadian clock control, transcription factor networks (FOXO1, FABP4), epigenetic regulators (UHRF1), and metabolic reprogramming. Encompasses in vitro models and primary cell culture systems.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular regulation of preadipocyte commitment and adipocyte differentiation, including circadian clock control and epigenetic reprogramming.

subtopics.label: Gametogenesis and Reproductive Development
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms of spermatogenesis, oogenesis, meiosis, and folliculogenesis, including genetic causes of male infertility, oocyte maturation signaling, and ovarian follicle dynamics. Encompasses progesterone receptor signaling in meiosis and assisted reproductive technology applications.
subtopics.short_description: Cellular and molecular mechanisms of spermatogenesis, oogenesis, meiosis, and folliculogenesis, including genetic causes of infertility.

subtopics.label: Lineage Plasticity and Cell Fate in Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on how developmental lineage programs, transcription factors, and epigenetic states govern cell fate plasticity in cancer, including histological transformation, neuroendocrine differentiation, and tumor cell state transitions. Encompasses glioma, lung, colorectal, and prostate cancer lineage reprogramming.
subtopics.display_name: Lineage Plasticity & Cell Fate in Cancer
subtopics.short_description: Developmental transcription factors and epigenetic states driving histological transformation and tumor cell state transitions across cancer types.

subtopics.label: Wnt and Hedgehog Developmental Signaling Pathways
subtopics.description: Research on the roles of Wnt and Hedgehog signaling pathways in tissue patterning, organogenesis, and cell fate specification during development and in disease contexts. Includes structural studies of Wnt secretion machinery and pathway activity in intestinal, hepatic, and skeletal tissues.
subtopics.short_description: Roles of Wnt and Hedgehog pathways in tissue patterning, organogenesis, and cell fate specification during development and disease.

subtopics.label: Airway Epithelial Cell Differentiation and Lung Disease
subtopics.description: Research on differentiation, cellular organization, and dysfunction of airway epithelial cells including club cells and basal stem/progenitor cells in the context of smoking, HIV, and COPD.
subtopics.short_description: Differentiation and dysfunction of airway epithelial progenitor cells in the context of smoking, HIV, and COPD.

subtopics.label: m6A RNA Modification and Epitranscriptomic Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies on m6A mRNA methylation machinery including METTL3 and YTHDF reader proteins, and their roles in post-transcriptional gene regulation and mRNA stability.
subtopics.short_description: m6A mRNA methylation machinery and reader proteins governing post-transcriptional gene regulation and mRNA stability.

subtopics.label: Glioma Stem Cells and Tumor Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research examining how the tumor microenvironment, including hypoxia and cellular states, supports glioma stem cell maintenance and influences glioblastoma biology and IDH-targeted therapy.
subtopics.short_description: Hypoxia and microenvironmental states supporting glioma stem cell maintenance and influencing glioblastoma biology and IDH-targeted therapy.

subtopics.label: B Cell Differentiation and Lymphomagenesis
subtopics.description: Studies on transcriptional and chromatin regulators including ARID1A and cohesin complex genes that control B cell fate decisions and contribute to germinal center-derived lymphoma.
subtopics.short_description: Transcriptional and chromatin regulators controlling B-cell fate decisions and germinal center-derived lymphoma development.

subtopics.label: IVF Embryo Assessment and Reproductive Technology
subtopics.description: Research applying computational and imaging approaches to assess human embryo quality, ploidy prediction, and blastocyst conversion rates in assisted reproductive technology.
subtopics.short_description: Computational and imaging approaches for evaluating human embryo quality, ploidy prediction, and blastocyst conversion in assisted reproduction.

subtopics.label: Maternal Programming of Offspring Development and Behavior
subtopics.description: Studies on how maternal factors including cytokines, hormones, and gestational environment program offspring neurodevelopment, immune function, and behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Gestational factors including cytokines and hormones that program offspring neurodevelopment, immune function, and behavior.

subtopics.label: Microglial Biology and Brain Innate Immunity
subtopics.description: Research on microglial subpopulations, their resistance to pharmacological depletion, and the role of innate immune cells in brain development and neurological disease.
subtopics.short_description: Microglial subpopulations and innate immune cell roles in brain development, pharmacological depletion resistance, and neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Endoderm Specification and Organ Patterning
subtopics.description: Research on transcription factor-mediated enhancer remodeling and signaling pathways that direct definitive endoderm specification and patterning of endoderm-derived organs including kidney and pancreas.
subtopics.short_description: Transcription factor-driven enhancer remodeling and signaling pathways directing endoderm specification and patterning of kidney and pancreas.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation and Entry into Quiescence
subtopics.description: Studies on molecular mechanisms controlling cell cycle progression, density-dependent quiescence, and the regulation of cyclin D1 and CDK inhibitors in proliferating cells.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms controlling cell cycle progression, density-dependent quiescence, and cyclin D1 and CDK inhibitor regulation.

subtopics.label: Tissue Regeneration and Stress Response Signaling
subtopics.description: Research on molecular regulators of tissue regeneration including Sirt1-mediated mitochondrial stress responses, nuclear pore remodeling, and cardiac scar-to-syncytium regeneration strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Sirt1-mediated mitochondrial stress responses, nuclear pore remodeling, and cardiac scar-to-syncytium regeneration strategies.

subtopics.label: iPSC Genome Editing and Disease Modeling Tools
subtopics.description: Methodological advances in CRISPR-based genome editing in human iPSCs and related tools including BAC vectors and iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells for disease modeling.
subtopics.display_name: iPSC Genome Editing & Disease Modeling Tools
subtopics.short_description: CRISPR-based genome editing advances in human iPSCs and derived cell types for modeling neurological and vascular disease.
